caption: The drawing shows a single wooden shoe last, which is a solid form shaped like a foot and used in shoemaking. The shoe last is positioned horizontally across a plain, light-colored background. The wooden surface is mostly medium brown with visible grain and texture, and there are darker brown and grayish areas, particularly near the toe and heel, which show signs of wear. There are two pieces of metal, one at the tip of the toe and another smaller piece on the upper part of the midsection. A circular hole is visible on the right, near the heel. The surface has striations and some scratch marks, adding detail to the depiction of the wood. The artist's signature and a date appear towards the lower left, and there is a small stamp or mark beneath it.
title: Shoe Last
